diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads f, so the compiler treats it as an update of f (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
This expression has no infix assignment form. If you mean an update, write one, e.g. f += 1.
It only matters when another region also writes f in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
